tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches the user's live Lingard account: vocabulary, learning context, English profile, totals, collection titles, saved words, flashcards, and missing vocabulary fields. Results are read from Firestore at the time of the call.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetches the full live Lingard JSON record for a search-result id (e.g. "learning-context:en") or a Lingard resource URI such as lingard://learning-context/en.

tools.name: lingard_get_learning_context
tools.description: Returns the user's current Lingard learning context, read live from their account: English profile, vocabulary totals, saved collections and their titles, card counts, and missing-field stats. Earlier answers in the conversation may be out of date; this is the account as it stands now. The list cove

tools.name: lingard_get_vocab_collection
tools.description: Returns live cards from one Lingard vocabulary collection by UUID or title, including curated Lingard collections and the "Words not in a collection" bucket of cards saved while reading. With includeExamples:true it also returns each card's example sentences and their translations, which editing exa

tools.name: lingard_get_collection_gaps
tools.description: Returns live Lingard cards in a collection that are missing requested fields such as translation, POS, pronunciation, examples, or image. A curated Lingard collection always reports zero gaps: its words come from the Lingard catalog and are not the user's to fill.

tools.name: lingard_get_word_suggestion_context
tools.description: Returns live Lingard profile level, topic, collection context, and the words the user already has: the context for suggesting level-appropriate new cards that are not duplicates.

tools.name: lingard_preview_vocab_changes
tools.description: Previews a Lingard vocabulary collection/card change without writing to Firestore. Cards are checked as on commit. Unless allowIncompleteCards is true, a new card needs title, translate, pos, pron/ipa, syns, and examples with translations; image is optional. A German or Romance noun title carries it

tools.name: lingard_commit_vocab_changes
tools.description: Commits a previously previewed or freshly supplied Lingard vocabulary change. Unless allowIncompleteCards is true, a new card needs title, translate, pos, pron/ipa, syns, and examples with translations; image is optional. A German or Romance noun title carries its dictionary article when one is used

tools.name: lingard_create_vocab_collection
tools.description: Creates a Lingard vocabulary collection, optionally with initial cards; commit=true writes it. Unless allowIncompleteCards is true, a new card needs title, translate, pos, pron/ipa, syns, and examples with translations; image is optional. A German or Romance noun title carries its dictionary article

tools.name: lingard_add_words_to_collection
tools.description: Adds cards to an existing Lingard collection, deduplicating by normalized word title; commit=true writes them. Only collections with writable="full" accept new cards: curated Lingard collections are read-only and the unfiled bucket takes no new cards. Unless allowIncompleteCards is true, a new card

tools.name: lingard_fill_missing_card_fields
tools.description: Fills empty fields on existing Lingard cards. It never overwrites or clears a field that already has a value. Works on the user's own collections and on the "Words not in a collection" bucket; curated Lingard collections are read-only because their content comes from the Lingard catalog. commit=true

tools.name: lingard_update_example_translations
tools.description: Rewrites only the translation line of examples that already exist on Lingard cards; the example sentence, its {} highlights and its audio/typing markers are left exactly as they are. tools.name: lingard_attach_card_images
tools.description: Attaches supplied images to existing Lingard cards. It does not generate images: each entry carries the image itself as imageBase64 or dataUri, or an imageUrl that the server downloads. tools.name: lingard_get_learning_pauses
tools.description: Lists, for one language, the user's collections and sources (books, the news) and which of them are on pause. findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
